subject: Post-call: token profile, budget range, and model routing priorities
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Ortiz <janelle@acmehealth.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: token profile, budget range, and model routing priorities

Hi Janelle / Tom —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and three asks so we can put pricing scenarios together: 

Summary from call:
- Primary use: patient triage chat + clinical note summarization + vector search for internal KB.
- Traffic shape: bursty during business hours, heavy short-chat volume (avg 35 tokens/request) and smaller embedding calls for nightly reindex (~10M embed ops/month).

Asks (so we can generate accurate $/1M token and model-mix pricing):
1) Ballpark monthly input+output tokens you expect during pilot and if you scale to production (e.g., 10M / 100M / 1B). If unsure, give ranges.
2) Target cost band for a baseline SLA — e.g., target $/1M tokens or monthly budget range for the pilot. If procurement needs an anchor price, share that.
3) Preferred model mix / priorities: do you want to prioritize cheapest throughput (smaller chat models), highest quality (larger chat models), or hybrid with routing (cheap baseline + quality fallback on reranks)? Also confirm embeddings vs chat split by percent if possible.

I'll put together three scenarios (conservative, balanced, quality-focused) and include per-model unit economics + suggested routing rules and KV cache settings. Attaching a short template and the usage CSV you can drop numbers into.

Next steps / timeline:
- You send ranges by EOD Wed 5/12 if possible.
- We deliver pricing scenarios and an initial routing playbook by Fri 5/14.

Thanks — enjoy the rest of your day.

Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment stubs: redwood_pricing_scenarios_v2.pdf (pdf), acme_usage_profile.csv (csv)

From: Janelle Ortiz <janelle@acmehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: token profile, budget range, and model routing priorities

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the clear recap. See answers below — these are high-level and we can refine once we pull usage logs.

1) Volume (monthly, pilot -> prod):
- Pilot (3 months): 8M–12M tokens/month aggregate
- Ramp (9–12 months): 40M–80M tokens/month
- Long-term target: 300M+ tokens/month (12–24 months if adoption goes well)

2) Budget / target $/1M tokens:
- For the pilot we are targeting roughly $600–$1,000 per 1M tokens as an internal "need to approve" band.
- If you can show a path to <$400 per 1M at scale (40M+ tokens/month) that would be compelling for procurement.

3) Model mix priorities and split (initial expectation):
- Chat (primary triage): ~70% of tokens — prefer lower-latency, cost-effective models but need reasonable clinical accuracy.
- Summarization / high-quality ops: ~15% of tokens — willing to route to higher-quality model for final notes.
- Embeddings / search: ~15% of ops (but note embeddings are measured differently — we measure as embed calls; estimate 10M embed ops/month at scale).

Routing preference: hybrid routing — baseline cheap model for 95% of chat and automatic escalation to higher-quality model for flagged intents (escalation rules TBD).

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through the usage CSV.

Best,
Janelle Ortiz
Head of Product
Acme Health

- Pilot volume 8–12M tokens/month, target $/1M tokens for pilot $600–$1,000.

Ben: quick ask on routing — do we have a short set of rules (latency threshold, confidence heuristic, or intent tag) we can recommend as booleans that Acme's engineering team can implement quickly? If you can add an ops note about fallback timeouts and estimated cost delta that will be useful.

If we hit the timeline I'll draft a short one-page exec summary for procurement with three anchor price points.

Thanks — Vivek

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: token profile, budget range, and model routing priorities

Vivek / Monica —

Quick note with recommended routing heuristics we can include in the playbook:
- Baseline: serve chat requests to model A (cost-optimized) for requests <= 60 tokens and low-risk intent tags.
- Escalation: if intent_tag in {"clinical-summary", "care-plan"} OR modelA_confidence < 0.65 then route to model B (higher-quality).
- Latency failover: if queue wait > 200ms and modelB not available, fallback to modelA with a notice header for downstream processing.
- Embeddings: batch nightly for reindex (throughput optimized) and use async embed endpoint to avoid steady-state cost spikes.

Estimated pilot cost (very rough):
- Conservative (pilot): $750 / 1M tokens -> ~ $6K–9K/month for 8–12M tokens + embeddings (embed costs billed separately).
- Balanced (pilot): $620 / 1M tokens -> ~ $5K–7.5K/month.
- Quality (pilot): $950 / 1M tokens -> ~ $7.6K–11.4K/month.

I'll attach the pricing scenarios PDF and a short ops note on TTL/batching.

Ben Carter
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference
